messages:
Omar: Heads up — Ada just got promoted to Senior PM AND she's expecting a baby in September! :tada: :baby: We were thinking potluck + card next Friday 12:30 in the kitchen. Thoughts?
Ada: omg thanks y'all!! 😭❤️ so excited. low-key overwhelmed but very happy. potluck sounds perfect.
Priya: congrats Ada!! can bring samosas + mango lassi.
Samir: i'll bring a cake. chocolate? or salted caramel? :cake: 
Lina: salted caramel all the way. also i'll make a "congrats Ada" sign.
Devon: can we do a group photo? count me in. can help with plates/utensils.
Omar: Poll: cake flavor — chocolate / salted caramel / lemon
Priya: chocolate is a close second for me.
Samir: salted caramel wins so far.
Ada: you guys are the best. modest sweater request: nothing too spicy pls 😂
KitchenBot: Reminder set for Fri 12:15 "Ada potluck + card" — invite sent to #all
Zoe: sending flowers if anyone wants to split cost? DM me.
Omar: i'll start the card around Wed — drop messages here if you want me to copy them in.
Priya: +1 on flowers, happy to chip in.
Samir: cheaper coffee shop gift card also works.
Lina: RSVP: yes. bringing sign + napkins.
Devon: RSVP: yes. bringing utensils + camera.
Ada: thank you everyone, can't wait. also does anyone have baby book recs? Short list? :)
Priya: "The Happiest Baby on the Block" and "Cribsheet"
Samir: "What to Expect" is a classic.
Omar: ok team — plan locked. salted caramel cake, sign, flowers combo. see you Friday :tada:
